review_scope: Independent read-only source review of the commit diff, fixture, driver, DOM reader, and hosted route. No test, browser, build, release, database, secret, or child-agent work was performed.

findings.finding: The claimed fixture, guard, import and format checks are listed as direct commands without resource journals or guarded run IDs. Their green counts are unadmitted evidence; a guarded verifier must produce completed journals before source checks are credited.

The one browser DOM-reader test for the new visible refusal was not collected because this checkout lacked a Playwright runtime. The predicate and actual PatternsTab markup align by inspection, but the refusal DOM check is unverified until a guarded run collects it.

oracle_assessment.stale_only: Fixture keeps one old target request pending, serves a current document with only a real warmup fetch, requires the old server response to finish after the warmup, and keeps target_requests at one. The worker assessor requires the old context terminal, a distinct current context, a binding handshake, one exact warmup packet and zero target packets before recovery.
oracle_assessment.refusal: The driver waits for one visible no-match guidance error, an idle enabled exact Run control, and absent saved-result header and preview before enabling recovery. The current app renders that error in the Patterns pane and clears running state in finally.
oracle_assessment.recovery: Only after refusal, a second saved Run triggers the fixture's fresh target request. The driver requires target_requests two, a fresh current binding packet, exact saved Canyon Frequency/current table, current page result, and no visible old result.
oracle_assessment.route_cleanup_receipt: Hosted route passes stale-only into the same CI-development artifact path. Existing cleanup verifies passive probe removal and exact owned-recipe deletion; the native harness result gates report success. The report uses booleans, counts, hashes and bounded trace fields rather than response bodies or credentials. A native receipt and resource decisions have not been produced for this mode.

unverified_scope: No native Chrome run or installed-artifact observation exists in this review. The fixture requires old HTTP finish at its server; whether the extension refuses the stale callback and recovers remains for the guarded native run.
